--Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Deep Chandra Joshi, learned counsel for the
applicant.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned AGA for the State.
3. The instant bail application is moved on behalf
of the applicant - "Shalu, son of Sukka" for seeking
bail in reference to FIR dated 20.07.2025 bearing FIR
No. 504 of 2025, registered at Police Station -
Mangalaur, District - Haridwar wherein the present
applicant has been implicated and charge sheeted for
the offences punishable under Section 64 (1), 74, 75, 115
(2), 127 (2) and 351 of BNS, 2023.
4. It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant
that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely
implicated. He further pointed out that the victim in
her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS,
2023 completely takes U - turn and has developed a
new story and he has been implicated only because of
the reason that applicant and victim's family are
residing in the same locality.
5. Apart from this, he submits that applicant is
languishing in jail since 29.09.2025 and has no criminal
antecedent and the charge sheet is filed without
collecting mobile of the applicant despite his request
and as such, there is no electronic evidence which
connect the applicant with the alleged incident. He
submits that investigation is already completed,
therefore, there is no need of further custodial
interrogation. He also pointed out that at the time of

incident, victim was major and arrest memo does not
discloses ground of arrest.
6. On perusal of the order sheet, it reveals that on
19.12.2025, time was given to the State to file counter
affidavit but till date no counter affidavit has been
filed, since last more than nine months, therefore, this
Court has no option except to enlarge the applicant on
bail considering the fact that he has already suffered
long incarceration of more than one year, though
charge sheet is already filed and furthermore, the
applicant has not criminal antecedents.
7. In such view of the matter, without expressing
any opinion on the merit of the case, the instant bail
application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant "Shalu, son of Sukka" be
released on bail, on executing personal bond and
furnishing two reliable sureties, each of like amount, to
the satisfaction of Court concerned.
